title: EDGE entities collaborate as CMD and SDF portfolio company Dronamics sign MoU on next-generation propulsion systems
summary: To jointly evaluate next-generation propulsion solutions for Dronamics’ Black Swan cargo drone

Under the agreement, the two parties will assess a range of potential pathways for the development of diversified advanced propulsion for the Dronamics Black Swan drone platform. Image Courtesy: EDGE Group

To jointly evaluate next-generation propulsion solutions for Dronamics’ Black Swan cargo drone

Press Release

Abu Dhabi, UAE: EDGE Group entity, CMD, a leading Italian company specialising in the design, prototyping and development of advanced propulsion systems for automotive, marine and aeronautical applications, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Dronamics, an aerospace company developing unmanned aerial systems for civilian and dual-use applications and a portfolio company of Strategic Development Fund (SDF), also an EDGE Group entity, to jointly evaluate next-generation propulsion solutions for Dronamics’ Black Swan cargo drone. The MoU was signed by Vencislav Hamanov, VP Global Supply Chain of Dronamics, and Giorgio Negri, Co-founder and Chief Commercial Officer of CMD, at the EDGE Europe office in Paris during the Euronaval naval defence and maritime security event.

Under the agreement, the two parties will assess a range of potential pathways for the development of diversified advanced propulsion for the Dronamics Black Swan drone platform, which includes integrating existing CMD engines, modifying and adapting current CMD engines, and designing and developing an entirely new power system. This collaboration also covers applicable aerospace certifications, as well as serial manufacturing and through-life support for the selected engine.

Dronamics is emerging as one of Europe’s leading aerospace and logistics innovators, specialising in the development of unmanned aerial systems (UAS) for civilian, commercial, and dual-use applications. Its capabilities centre on long-range, high-payload autonomous cargo delivery, redefining the possibilities of air freight and logistics. SDF is Dronamics’ largest investor to date through its venture capital investments, while CMD was recently acquired by EDGE to significantly lay the foundation for the expansion of a high-quality engine production base in Europe and strengthens EDGE’s global propulsion capabilities.  

About EDGE

Launched in November 2019, the UAE’s EDGE is one of the world’s leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

With a focus on the adoption of 4IR technologies, EDGE is driving the development of sovereign capabilities for global export and for the preservation of national security, working with front-line operators, international partners, 

and adopting advanced technologies such as autonomous capabilities, cyber-physical systems, advanced propulsion systems, robotics and smart materials. EDGE converges R&D, emerging technologies, digital transformation, and commercial market innovations with military capabilities to develop disruptive solutions tailored 

to the specific requirements of its customers. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, capital of the UAE, EDGE consolidates more than 35 entities into seven core clusters: Platforms & Systems, Missiles & Weapons, Advanced Sensing, EDGE Commercial, Secure Intelligence Systems, Technologies & Industrialisation, and Homeland Security.
